'''2020 TMW Pods Ming Huo DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ming Huo]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ming Huo]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Hunt Down And Destroy The Je Huo DS.txt |Download]]
